caption: This is spicy ramen with a rich, reddish broth. Topped with chashu pork, a halved egg, nori, and green onions, it sits in a black bowl on a wooden table, bathed in warm, inviting light.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, smooth grain pattern, and subtle light reflections.
Chashu pork slice shows tender, pale pink meat with visible fat marbling and slightly uneven, cooked surface.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly rough, uneven surface.
The spicy broth is rich, amber-orange, glossy, and contains visible noodles and toppings.
A halved boiled egg shows a firm, pale yellow yolk surrounded by smooth, white albumen.
Black ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, rounded rim.
A glossy red spoon with a smooth, curved surface and slightly worn handle edge.
